mentions.name: ShowOffer
mentions.description: This web tool turns a user's GitHub activity into numbers and charts for performance reviews and 1:1s. Users pick a period and their repos and get a report showing PRs merged, reviews given, time to merge, and biggest PRs, compared against the previous period. It can be tried with sample data without connecting GitHub.
mentions.problem: Before every review the author wonders 'Was I productive? Did I do a good job?' — GitHub work is hard to summarize and quantify for performance reviews.
mentions.audience: People preparing for performance reviews and 1:1s who want to quantify their GitHub work
